name: Calicat · Gremlet #20
description:
A calico kitten that naps in every sunbeam and chases every dust mote.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Calicat in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
